statement: ∀ (q ρ : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < ρ → (N : ℝ) ≤ 2 / ρ → (N : ℝ≥0∞) * (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt 2 * ρ)) ^ (q + 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (Real.sqrt 2) ^ (q + 1)) * (ENNReal.ofReal ρ) ^ q
proof:
intro q ρ N hρ hN
have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
have hid : (2 / ρ) * (Real.sqrt 2 * ρ) ^ (q + 1) = (2 * (Real.sqrt 2) ^ (q + 1)) * ρ ^ q := by
  rw [Real.mul_rpow hs.le hρ.le, Real.rpow_add_one (ne_of_gt hρ)]
  field_simp
  <;> ring
have hr : (N : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt 2 * ρ) ^ (q + 1) ≤ (2 * (Real.sqrt 2) ^ (q + 1)) * ρ ^ q := by
  rw [← hid]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
have he := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hr
simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg N), ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt 2) ^ (q + 1)), ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_pos (mul_pos hs hρ), ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_pos hρ] using he

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (GDVec n)),
  (∀ (m : ℕ) (A : Set (GDVec m)),
      0 ≤ dimH A ∧
        ∀ (s : ℝ),
          0 < s →
            GDMeasure s A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure s) A ∧
              (ENNReal.ofReal s < dimH A → GDMeasure s A = ∞) ∧
                (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal s → GDMeasure s A = 0) ∧
                  (GDMeasure s A < ∞ → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧
                    (GDMeasure s A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧ (GDMeasure s A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal s ≤ dimH A)) →
    Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
        0 ≤ dimH E ∧
          dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧
            dimH E < ∞ ∧ (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → GDContent s δ E < ∞) ∧ (n = 0 → E = Set.univ ∧ dimH E = 0) →
      (dimH GDInterval = 1 ∧
          (∀ (a : ℝ), 1 < a → GDMeasure a GDInterval = 0) ∧
            (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → s < 1 → 0 < δ → ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ (s - 1)) ≤ GDContent s δ GDInterval) ∧
              ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s < 1 → GDMeasure s GDInterval = ∞) →
        (1 ≤ n → ∀ (q r ε : ℝ), dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q → 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → 0 < ε → GDPositiveCover E q r ε) →
          ((∀ (x y : GDVec n) (t u : ℝ), dist (GDPoint x t) (GDPoint y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
              ∀ (z : GDVec (n + 1)), ∃ x t, z = GDPoint x t) →
            ∀ (q ρ : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
              0 < ρ →
                ↑N ≤ 2 / ρ →
                  ↑N * ENNReal.ofReal (√2 * ρ) ^ (q + 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * √2 ^ (q + 1)) * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ q
'YuiAuxiliary.checked' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
